Adults 18+; no volunteer experience needed. Reserve a slot via the sign-up form on the page, then get matched with a dog; check in at ACCT Philly (111 W. Hunting Park Ave). Outings of a few hours, a day or a weekend; no dog parks. Backpack of supplies and GPS collar provided; fill out an online report card.
